final:
type Shape = Rect(w: int, h: int) | Square(side: int) | Tri(b: int, h: int)

-- True when every dimension of the shape is non-negative.
valid(s: Shape) -> bool =
  ex valid(Rect(w: 2, h: 3))
  ex valid(Square(side: 0))
  ex not valid(Tri(b: -1, h: 4))
  match s
    Rect(w:, h:) -> w >= 0 and h >= 0
    Square(side:) -> side >= 0
    Tri(b:, h:) -> b >= 0 and h >= 0

-- Area rounded down. A triangle is b*h/2, floored.
area(s: Shape) -> int =
  pre valid(s)
  post out >= 0
  ex area(Rect(w: 2, h: 3)) == 6
  ex area(Square(side: 4)) == 16
  ex area(Tri(b: 3, h: 3)) == 4
  ex area(Tri(b: 5, h: 2)) == 5
  match s
    Rect(w:, h:) -> w * h
    Square(side:) -> side * side
    Tri(b:, h:) -> (b * h) // 2

test_area() =
  assert area(Rect(w: 2, h: 3)) == 6
  assert area(Square(side: 4)) == 16
  assert area(Tri(b: 3, h: 3)) == 4
  assert area(Tri(b: 5, h: 2)) == 5
